summary: The PR addresses the issue by checking if the db_table is the same before performing the rename operation, which is a reasonable approach. However, there are some minor style issues.

issues.description: There is an unnecessary blank line after the if condition.
The line `old_model._meta.db_table == new_model._meta.db_table` can be simplified to `old_model._meta.db_table == new_model._meta.db_table` without the extra space.
The added `reproduce.py` file is not part of the standard test suite and might not be maintained or executed regularly. It could be useful to add a comment or documentation explaining its purpose.
